verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance has first-party webhooks documentation stating that webhooks deliver real-time notifications when specific events occur, replacing polling. However, the API for subscribing to specific events (OBWMS) is described in future tense ('will provide'), so programmatic per-event subscription is not yet shown as available. Missing for 10: a documented, currently available API for registering and managing webhook subscriptions, an event catalog and payload details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when specific events occur, eliminating the need for constant polling.
OBWMS will provide a comprehensive API for managing real-time event notifications, enabling you to subscribe to specific events, ensuring you only receive relevant updates.
